svg.title: APC electrical I/O overview (example)
svg.text: APC electrical I/O overview – sensors, valves, drive, safety (example addresses from §4.11 + additions of §24.4)
Siemens-style example: S7-1500F CPU + ET 200SP on the APC base, PROFINET + PROFIsafe. Same tags on circuit, schematic, I/O list and device label (guide 15).
standard + F program: step chain, interlocks,
SS1 / STO, door locking, accumulator logic
OPC UA to the twin / MES (cycle data)
-KF2 remote I/O station on the APC base (IP20 in a box, or IP67 modules)
• 24 V DC PELV (IEC 60204-1); sensors PNP; valves with LED +
suppressor diode; separate fused circuits for sensors and valves.
• Safety functions on F-modules, 2 channels, test pulses, PL d
(ISO 13849-1); E-stop also hard-wired between APC and HMC.
• Analog 0B2: wire break < 3.6 mA = fault → no pallet change.
• IO-Link sensors give diagnosis (switching distance reserve,
temperature) – feed the twin for predictive maintenance.
• Signal count (example): 16 + 4 DI, 12 DQ, 4 F-DI, 1 F-DQ, 2 AI
≈ 40 signals → one remote I/O box on the APC base.
Digital twin · values: web/apc.js defaults, guide 25 §14
